answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rely on each identity generating a unique sonnet of computational proofs that must be pigmented with private entropy and then terrace-verified by independent peers. Attackers pay the full cost of crafting fresh sonnets with distinct pigment for every fake identity%2C as shared or recycled proofs fail the terrace consensus checks and are rejected%2C making mass impersonation prohibitively expensive to sustain.
